_comment: A pinned, unmodified copy of two Az.KeyVault cmdlet help pages, as their source in Azure/azure-powershell, from which the Learn reference pages are generated: Add-AzKeyVaultCertificate (example 1 creates a self-signed certificate from a policy) and Set-AzKeyVaultCertificatePolicy (example 1 sets a certificate policy). Learn's tutorial 'Configure certificate autorotation in Key Vault' isn't published in a public MicrosoftDocs repository (it left MicrosoftDocs/azure-docs in August 2024), so its source can't be pinned; these examples are the closest public Microsoft source for creating and renewing a Key Vault certificate from PowerShell. Never edit these files: update the snapshot by copying a newer upstream commit and regenerating this manifest in a reviewed pull request. scripts/tests/test_third_party_snapshots.py fails when a file stops matching its hash.
name: Microsoft samples: Az.KeyVault Add-AzKeyVaultCertificate and Set-AzKeyVaultCertificatePolicy (example 1)
license: Microsoft Software License Terms for Microsoft Azure PowerShell (LICENSE, copied from the repository root's LICENSE.txt).
not_copied: The other Az.KeyVault help pages and the cmdlets' code; the versioned copies Learn renders from MicrosoftDocs/azure-docs-powershell (azps-16.4.0), which add front matter to the same text.
Learn's tutorial 'Configure certificate autorotation in Key Vault', whose source isn't in a public repository; the chapter cites it.
